summary: Hugepage unmap reads h->surplus_huge_pages without hugetlb_lock while surplus allocation updates the same hstate counter.

call_chain.evidence: KCSAN read side and patch hunk are in this function.
KCSAN write side names alloc_surplus_hugetlb_folio and hugetlb.ll defines it.

interleaving: The unmap path drops a huge PTE and decides whether to restore a reservation based on h->surplus_huge_pages.
A concurrent surplus allocation updates the hstate surplus counter under hugetlb_lock.
The fix takes hugetlb_lock around the unmap-side check and reinitializes adjust_reservation per loop iteration.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: All accesses to the hstate surplus counter that influence reservation restore decisions must be under hugetlb_lock.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: The counter determines whether a hugetlb reservation should be restored during unmap and is also maintained by the surplus allocator.

aliases.name: h->surplus_huge_pages
aliases.evidence: The allocator receives the hstate pointer and increments the counter.

thread_a.evidence: __unmap_hugepage_range derives h from the VMA before the check.

thread_b.evidence: The allocator directly mutates the supplied hstate.

notes: The same patch also fixes adjust_reservation initialization, but the concurrency surface is h->surplus_huge_pages.

coverage.analysis_conclusion: Both real contexts and the shared counter access are in mm/hugetlb.c.

patch_hunks: 21cc2b5c5062 adds hugetlb_lock around the h->surplus_huge_pages check in __unmap_hugepage_range.
indirect_edges: hstate_vma(vma) maps the unmap VMA to the shared hstate object.
